messages:
owen: Quick sync — SFO4 cutover tomorrow 09:00 PT. Two things we need green:
1) proxy cache eviction behavior for residency routes (prefix caching TTL override)
2) egress routing policy to ensure egress stays within CA jurisdictions for regulated tenants.

Anyone owning the proxy-side config + PR status?

marta: I own the proxy config change. PR at https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/proxy/pulls/412 — awaiting review. Changes are small: add header-based TTL override + route tag check. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jamal: On routing policy side — I updated route-table generator to include region_tag filtering. PR https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/router/pulls/198. Tests passing locally but need infra SRE to validate egress path.

cecilia: infra-sre can validate after deploy window. @infra-sre can you run smoke tomorrow 10:00 PT? We'll need an endpoint to hit: `https://sfo4-proxy.redwood.test/health?route=residency`

infra-sre: noted. Scheduling smoke at 10:00 PT. Also posting quick command to capture egress AS path:
```
curl -v https://sfo4-proxy.redwood.test/health?route=residency -H 'x-tenant: cu-123' --resolve sfo4-proxy.redwood.test:443:10.2.3.4
```
Will capture ip and AS. :train2:

priya: small heads-up — data-residency teams require audit log entries for any cache-override decisions. Marta, add a log line like `cache_override=region_tag` in the change.

marta: will add log. Also adding feature flag `residency.cache_override_v1` for safe rollback.

owen: Thanks. Action items:
- marta: add log + feature flag, merge PR after review (owner)
- jamal: get infra-sre validation + upload smoke results (owner)
- infra-sre: run smoke, capture AS/path, confirm egress (owner)
- priya: confirm audit log format with legal (owner)

Quick ask: anyone blocking CA compliance sign-off? CC @cecilia

cecilia: legal is okay pending smoke. Priya to confirm log format.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to sfo4-staging at 2024-10-07T17:00Z (rollout type: canary)

marta: pinging @jamal for final review — PT window is tight.

jamal: taking a look now, will approve if smoke passes. :thumbsup:

owen: great — will follow up after smoke. Thanks all.
